title: Implement the Sieve of Eratosthenes in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement primes_up_to(limit: usize) -> Vec<usize> that returns all prime numbers up to and including limit using the Sieve of Eratosthenes algorithm.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement primes_up_to in src/lib.rs.

pub fn primes_up_to(limit: usize) -> Vec<usize>

Algorithm (Sieve of Eratosthenes):
1. Create a bool vec `is_prime` of size limit+1, all true.
2. Set is_prime[0] = is_prime[1] = false (if limit >= 1).
3. For p from 2 to sqrt(limit):
   if is_prime[p]: mark all multiples of p starting from p*p as false.
4. Collect all i where is_prime[i] is true.

Return empty vec for limit < 2.

All 5 tests in tests/sieve_test.rs must pass.
Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
